topic: Superposition and Quantum States: The Mechanics of 'Both/And'

sections.title: The Classical vs. Quantum Divide
lecture_lines: Classical bits exist as either 0 or 1.
Quantum states live in a complex Hilbert space.
Imagine a toggle switch versus a dimmer knob.
The dimmer represents infinite states between ON and OFF.
This defines the basis of quantum superposition.
animations: Show binary 0 and 1 as two distinct, static toggle switches [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/switch.svg] in white (#FFFFFF).
Display a sphere in blue (#0000FF) growing and pulsing to represent Hilbert space.
Animate a vector moving within the sphere to illustrate non-binary, continuous state possibilities, controlled by a rotating knob [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/knob.svg].

sections.title: Defining Superposition via Dirac Notation
lecture_lines: Superposition follows the state vector formula.
State vector equals alpha times 0 plus beta times 1.
Alpha and beta are complex probability amplitudes.
A spinning coin embodies this combined state.
The weights of 0 and 1 change dynamically.
animations: Display MathTex '|ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩' in yellow (#FFFF00) at the center.
Animate two gauge bars, one for |0⟩ and one for |1⟩, filling/emptying in inverse correlation.
Show a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coin.svg] graphic spinning rapidly with varying blur intensity to represent superposition.

sections.title: Measurement: The Collapse of the Wavefunction
lecture_lines: The Born rule governs probability calculations.
The squares of amplitudes must sum to one.
Measurement forces the system into one basis state.
Schrödinger's cat provides our intuitive analogy.
Opening the box collapses the wavefunction instantly.
animations: Display MathTex '|α|² + |β|² = 1' in orange (#FFA500) to represent the Born Rule with a cat [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] sitting next to it.
Animate a blurred spinning blur graphic (the 'superposition') transitioning into a solid, sharp image inside a box [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/box.svg].
Flash a bright white (#FFFFFF) 'camera' effect using the camera icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/camera.svg] over the screen to signify the collapse.

sections.title: Visualizing Quantum States: The Bloch Sphere
lecture_lines: The Bloch sphere maps these quantum states.
Complex coefficients define points on the surface.
Superposition is a rotation in this space.
animations: Display the 3D Bloch Sphere [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] in white wireframe (#FFFFFF).
Map coefficients onto the sphere surface, showing points moving as rotation.
Highlight the North pole as |0⟩ and South pole as |1⟩ in green (#00FF00).
Trace a path on the surface with a neon-colored arrow to show state evolution.
Overlay coordinate markers to emphasize the geometric nature of superposition.

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Superposition allows simultaneous processing of possibilities.
Quantum computers explore all paths at once.
Quantum reality is fundamentally 'both/and' logic.

Show all paths fading except for the 'correct' path which flashes bright red (#FF0000).
